objective: Model explicitly declared fixture solids and mounted cutting/shank/holder envelopes against complete native NC motion; preserve independent actual material/CAD comparison.
implementation_steps: Add opt-in native full-path export before surface computation, keeping the selected engine unchanged.
Prove continuous swept axial-cylinder versus box checks for every native linear motion; account conservatively for existing arc chord error.
Bind envelopes and obstacles to unchanged native NC, original CAD/material frame and independent mounted tool lengths.
Verify clear, cutting collision, holder collision and rapid crossing controls on existing simple FreeCAD NC, with original material evidence preserved.
Integrate qualified resource input and results into standard preparation/run; archive inputs before new complete runs.
Publish the new scope with CAD/IoU, resource configuration and motion evidence after a new independent page reviewer.

initial_scope.controller: existing strict metric static-Z tool-length backend
initial_scope.fixture_solids: explicit axis-aligned boxes in unchanged original CAD/material frame
initial_scope.mounted_tools: finite positive cylinders with independent axial start/end from actual tool tip
initial_scope.changes_between_moves: static fixture geometry; ordinary programmed tool change poses only

algorithm: Analytic minimum planar segment-to-rectangle distance restricted to the exact axial-overlap parameter interval; conservative outer envelope proves clearance, eroded inner envelope witnesses robust collision, gap/contact remains indeterminate.
